title: Raku Kiln Rental
source_quote:
Kiln Firing Services in Kansas City for Ceramic Artists
Back Door Pottery provides professional kiln firing services in Kansas City for ceramic artists who need reliable firing for pottery, sculpture, and ceramic work.
evidence_sentence: The page lists raku firings as an available kiln rental option with the 3 cubic foot raku kiln available at $35 minimum per load.
how_to_join: Contact the studio to reserve kiln space in advance.
summary: Back Door Pottery rents a 3 cubic foot raku kiln to outside artists for $35 minimum per load. You must be present to assist in loading and unloading; advance scheduling required.
